quote: Preference alignment optimizes LLMs using feedback that reflects human preferences. Given an oracle safety reward r*, the goal of safety alignment is to ensure that for any response pair y_i, y_j generated by aligned policy π_θ with prompt x, it holds that π_θ(y_i|x) > π_θ(y_j|x) only if r*(y_i) > r*(y_j).
Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved significant advancements in various domains, accompanied by growing safety concerns.
outputs: The paper focuses on generating safe responses by aligning LLMs with human values, particularly in avoiding harmful or toxic outputs during language generation.
